links.outcome: Image quality, artifact suppression, and repeat acquisitions, AI-optimized vs technologist-optimized cine protocol
links.effect: Image quality 3.69 vs 3.00 (p<0.001); artifact suppression 3.19 vs 2.17 (p<0.001); repeats 6 vs 19 (p=0.028). Nonrandomized, fixed order; no patient outcomes measured.
links.quote: The AI-optimized protocol reduced repeat acquisitions by 68% (6 vs. 19 repeats, p = 0.028).

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented LLM generating patient-adaptive imaging acquisition protocols

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluates a retrieval-augmented LLM to optimize cardiac MRI scanning protocols on real patients compared to technologist protocols, but it tests the performance of the AI tool itself rather than a deployment safeguard or operational practice.
